'''Remove Fatigue''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] in the Control family of abilities. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] used the power to remove and combat the effects of strenuous activity and work. By manipulating [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Jedi could expel bodily toxins more efficiently to maintain their stamina. Despite the use of the power, the Jedi still had to [[Foodstuff/Legends|eat]] and drink as normal.
